description: R08 DeserializationTests fragment seam: portable Rust owns fragment profile updates, fragment-only action materialization, ignored fragment key bindings, nested/iterable commands and non-persistence across user-settings round-trip.

entries.notes: FragmentSettings applies multiple updates to existing builtin profile identities without creating duplicates, permits fragment name override, and materializes a new explicit profile.
Named fragment actions are materialized into the runtime fragment action map.
Fragment action keys are deliberately ignored while the named action remains available.
Named fragment parents preserve valid nested command collections.
Unnamed fragment nested-command parents are ignored, matching the normal ActionMap rule that nested parents cannot auto-generate names.
iterateOn=schemes expands one fragment nested-command template once per currently available color scheme.
Fragment actions are runtime additions and are intentionally absent from the serialized user settings, so reparsing user JSON alone does not resurrect them.
